verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an unreadable speck at the top. The NEW FLAVOR badge has been moved down to sit just above the CTA at nearly the same size and pill shape, so it reads as a second button and competes with the real CTA. The CTA pill nearly touches both side edges, and the can has lost its sun mark. B: keeps the original order (badge, logo with sun, can, headline, copy, CTA) and the brand intact. However, the 'Chase the Light' headline is small and weak for the main message, the body copy is tiny, the CTA runs almost edge to edge, and the bottom has dead space.
